title: Fort Buchanan Education Center empowers Soldiers through Army education benefits
summary: The Fort Buchanan Education Center in Puerto Rico helps Soldiers maximize Army education benefits, offering advising, enrollment assistance and career preparation. The center supports service members pursuing college degrees, improving military qualifications and planning post-service careers, guiding them through eligibility, paperwork and connecting them with local schools and resources.
content:
Whether pursuing a college degree, improving military qualifications or preparing for future career opportunities, Soldiers in Puerto Rico have a dedicated resource to help them make the most of the Army's education benefits.

The Fort Buchanan Education Center provides one-on-one advising and information about the range of benefits available to Soldiers, including tuition assistance and federal education programs. Advisors help service members understand eligibility, verify benefits, select appropriate academic or vocational programs and navigate the enrollment process with civilian institutions.

Staff at the center work to tailor guidance to each Soldier's goals, whether that means completing a degree while serving, attaining certifications that support military occupational specialties, or preparing for a transition to civilian employment. The center also assists with paperwork, certification of enrollment and communication with schools and benefitting agencies to reduce administrative barriers.

Soldiers who use the center report that having a local, knowledgeable resource simplifies what can otherwise be a complex process. The office emphasizes proactive planning, helping service members align coursework with career objectives and ensuring credits and certifications apply toward long-term goals.

The Fort Buchanan Education Center also coordinates with installation units and education partners across Puerto Rico to host workshops, informational sessions and enrollment events. These efforts aim to increase awareness of available benefits and encourage continuous learning throughout a Soldier's career.
